title: Technology Sector Update for 08/20/2018: ESLT,SEII,BABA,AAPL
text:

Technology stocks have turned little changed shortly before Monday's closing bell, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing less than 0.1% while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was up less than 0.1%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Elbit Systems ( ESLT ) climbed almost 4% on Monday, finishing near its session high, after Israeli antitrust authorities signed off on the avionics and airborne monitors company's proposed $522 million acquisition of state-owned rival IMI Systems, Reuters reported. Elbit announced the transaction in June and will pay $495 million when the deal closes and up to $27 million more as IMI meets certain performance goals.
In other sector news:
+ Alibaba ( BABA ) climbed as much as 2.5% on Monday following reports the Chinese e-commerce platform is talking with India-based Reliance Retail about a potential joint venture, which could also include a $5 billion investment in India's largest retail chain.
- Apple ( AAPL ) shares were slightly more than 1% lower this afternoon after the tech giant reportedly removed up to 25,000 illegal apps previously sold by its App Store in China. The removed apps represent roughly 1.4% of the 1.8 million apps available on the website, with many selling fare lottery tickets or providing illegal gambling services, according to the Wall Street Journal, citing data from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
- Sharing Economy International ( SEII ) fell almost 7% on Monday after the firm agreed to buy 60% of Gagfare, an online platform to search flights, for $3.6 million in stock. Under the terms of the transaction, the company will issue 1.2 million shares of its preferred stock, valuing privately held Gagfare at about $3.061 per preferred share.
